signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: Pick a demo account. Your identity decides which documents you can see.

home.title: Home
home.text: What's new, the questions you asked, and recently added documents.

qa.title: Ask
qa.text: Tap a suggested question. Every answer cites its sources.

source.title: Ask · Sources
source.text: Click a citation number to read the original passage on the right.

mentions.title: Ask · Mentioned
mentions.text: Click an entity mentioned in the answer to see it and its relations on the right.

refusal.title: Ask · No answer
refusal.text: Nothing this identity can see covers the question, so it says so and suggests what to try.

switchIdentity.title: Switch identity
switchIdentity.text: Sign in as a Manager and ask the same question: confidential documents now answer it.

graph.title: Graph
graph.text: Search for an entity, expand it, and read its details in the entity panel.

path.title: Graph · Find path
path.text: Find how two entities connect, step by step.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: Browse documents by date, filter by entity, and expand a card.

upload.title: Upload
upload.text: Paste text, check the details in the confirmation, then watch extraction run.

myUploads.title: My uploads
myUploads.text: Every upload and where it stands.

review.title: Review
review.text: Extracted entities and relations wait here. Groups that need a decision are flagged.

conflict.title: Review · Differing statements
conflict.text: A new statement that disagrees with an existing one is shown side by side.

approve.title: Review · Approve
approve.text: Approve everything in the document in one go.

evals.title: Evals (?tools=evals, for delivery)
evals.text: Run the question set and check the citation, answer, and refusal metrics.

report.title: Quality report
report.text: Download the quality report as a single HTML file.

presentation.title: Presentation mode (?mode=presentation)
presentation.text: For demos: compare identities side by side on the same question.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.text: The same features on a phone.

signIn.title: 登入
signIn.text: 選一個展示帳號登入。身分決定你看得到哪些文件。

home.title: 首頁
home.text: 有哪些更新、問過的問題，以及最近新增的文件。

qa.title: 問答
qa.text: 點一個預設問題，每個回答都附上出處。

source.title: 問答・出處
source.text: 點引用標號，在右側看原文。

mentions.title: 問答・回答提到
mentions.text: 點「回答提到」的實體，在右側看它與相關的實體。

refusal.title: 問答・拒答
refusal.text: 這個身分看得到的文件中沒有答案，系統直接說明，並建議可以試試的方向。

switchIdentity.title: 切換身分
switchIdentity.text: 改用主管登入，問同一題：看得到機密文件，回答就不同。

graph.title: 圖譜
graph.text: 搜尋一個實體、展開，在實體面板看它的資料。

path.title: 圖譜・找路徑
path.text: 找出兩個實體之間怎麼連起來。

timeline.title: 時間軸
timeline.text: 依日期瀏覽文件、依實體篩選，展開卡片看內容。

upload.title: 上傳
upload.text: 貼上文字，在確認視窗核對資料，接著看萃取的進度。

myUploads.title: 我的上傳
myUploads.text: 每一份上傳目前的狀態。

review.title: 待審
review.text: 萃取出的實體與關係在這裡等待審核，需要決定的一組會標示出來。

conflict.title: 待審・說法不同
conflict.text: 新文件與既有文件說法不同時，兩段並列比較。

approve.title: 待審・核准
approve.text: 一次核准這份文件的所有項目。

evals.title: 評測台（?tools=evals，交付用）
evals.text: 執行題庫，查看引用、回答與拒答的指標。

report.title: 品質報告
report.text: 下載品質報告，一個 HTML 檔。

presentation.title: 展示模式（?mode=presentation）
presentation.text: 展示用：同一題，並排比較不同身分的回答。

mobile.title: 手機
mobile.text: 手機上也是同樣的功能。
